# Parentheses

> **这页管什么**：重要信息不要放括号里——读者会跳过。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/parentheses> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## When to avoid

**Don't put important information in parentheses if you can help it** — some readers skip parenthetical text entirely.

Before using parentheses, consider whether commas, dashes, semicolons, or periods would work as well.

## Length

Keep the parenthetical thought short. If the aside is lengthy, split it into two sentences.

## Punctuation placement

When an entire independent sentence is enclosed in parentheses, the period goes **inside** the closing parenthesis.

## Examples

- Preferred: an em dash for a short example — "Enter a name for the instance—for example, `my-instance-99`".
- Preferred: splitting instructions and examples into two full sentences rather than cramming both into one.
- Discouraged: placing an entire example inside parentheses when a dash would work better.
- Discouraged: embedding a lengthy conditional explanation inside parentheses mid-sentence.

## Related

Don't use parentheses to mark optional plural endings — "item(s)". See: pluralization.
